the Gunion-Bertsh formula is valid only when the transverse momentum of the emitted gluon is large compared to the mass of the emitting quark and the energy of the emitted gluons are small compared to the energy of the emitting quarks and gluons.
the Gunion-Betsch formula is a good approximation to the exact result for the gluon spectrum in the limit of small gluon transverse momentum and large gluon emission angle.
the spectrum of gluons emitted in g+g -> 3g reaction has been calculated in the leading order of perturbative QCD by relaxing the approximations used earlier.

the study of the soft gluon radiation from the process gg -> gg.
the study of the spectrum of soft gluons emitted by a fast gluon in an equilibrium gluon plasma.
the study of the soft gluon emission from a gluon moving in a gluon plasma.

the Gunion-Bersch formula is a good approximation for the spectrum of soft gluons in the gluon plasma.
the formula obtained by Gunion and Bertsch for soft gluon emission in the process g + g -> g + g + g is not valid in all the regions of phase space.
the Gunion-Bersch formula is valid only when the energy of the emitted gluon is much smaller than the energy of the incoming gluons.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Gunion-Bertch formula for the soft gluon radiation is not valid in the case of the gluon plasma.
the formula obtained in this paper can be applied to estimate physical quantity like equilibration time of gluons and energy loss of fast moving gluons in the gluonic matter.
the Gunion-Bertsh formula is not a very good one.

the energy loss of gluons in the plasma can be estimated by using the Gunion-Bersch formula.
the spectrum of emitted gluon is a strong function of temperature of the plasma and the spectrum of emitted soft gluon is not a power law.
